# function: filecontains

Given a path, return boolean depending on whether the file content matches the search string.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "true" {
  value = provider::foxfunx::filecontains("/etc/hosts", "localhost")
}
# returns true

output "false" {
  value = provider::foxfunx::filecontains("/etc/hosts", "hostlocal")
}
# returns false
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
filecontains(file_path string, search_text string) bool
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `file_path` (String) Path to the file.
1. `search_text` (String) Text to search in the file content.
